Value a scheduled liability, match its duration with two Treasury securities, and construct a cash flow matching bond ladder.

## Scope

Results describe the supplied historical snapshot or a stated simulation. Model fit and scenario estimates are not evidence of performance on new observations. See the project README for the execution record and limitations.

```{r}
source("R/analytics_support.R")
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
load("Data/liability_market.RData")
```

```{r}
settle <- calendar_date(2025,05,03)
```

```{r}
# Build a data table of the five liability payment dates and amounts
df <- data.table(maturity = seq(from = calendar_date(2025,08,15), by = "6 months", length.out = 5))
df <- df[, amount := c(100000, 105000, 110000, 115000, 120000)]

# Merge ci STRIPS prices into the liability table by matching on maturity date
liab <- merge(df, ci, by = "maturity", all.x = TRUE)

# PV of each payment = amount * (ci_price / 100); sum to get total PV
pv.liab <- sum(liab$amount * liab$ci_price / 100)
```

```{r}
round(pv.liab,0)
```

```{r}
# Time to maturity in years (using actual/365 day count)
liab[, ttm  := as.numeric(maturity - settle) / 365]

# Spot rate implied by each STRIPS price (semi-annual compounding)
liab[, spot := spot_yield(ci_price, ttm)]

# Modified duration of each individual cash flow
liab[, dmod := ttm / (1 + spot / 2)]

# PV weight of each cash flow relative to total liability PV
liab[, wt := (amount * ci_price / 100) / pv.liab]

# Liability modified duration = PV-weighted average of individual modified durations
dmod.liab <- sum(liab$wt * liab$dmod)
```

```{r}
round(dmod.liab,3)
```

```{r}
# First-order approximation: percent change = -D_mod * change in yield
dy    <- 0.001       # 10 basis points = 0.001 in decimal
pcpb  <- -dmod.liab * dy
```

```{r}
round(pcpb*100,3)
```

```{r}
# Build a data table with the two candidate bonds
portf <- data.table(
  maturity = c(calendar_date(2026,5,15), calendar_date(2028,2,15)),
  coupon   = c(0.03625, 0.02750)
)

# Pull in market clean prices from the coupons dataset
portf <- coupons[portf, on = .(maturity, coupon)]

# Standard Treasury pricing conventions
freq      <- 2          # semi-annual coupons
conv      <- "ACT/ACT"  # actual/actual day count
comp.freq <- 2          # semi-annual compounding

# Compute YTM for each bond from its clean price
portf[, yield := mapply(
  function(m, c, p) bond.yield(settle, m, c, freq, p, conv, comp.freq),
  maturity, coupon, bd_price
)]

# Compute modified duration for each bond
portf[, dmod := mapply(
  function(m, c, y) bond.duration(settle, m, c, freq, y, conv, modified = TRUE, comp.freq),
  maturity, coupon, yield
)]
```

```{r}
# Solve for Bond A weight using the duration-matching formula
w1 <- (dmod.liab - portf$dmod[2]) / (portf$dmod[1] - portf$dmod[2])
portf[, wt := c(w1, 1 - w1)]

# Dollar market value allocated to each bond
portf[, mv := wt * pv.liab]

# Accrued interest for each bond on settlement date
portf[, accint := mapply(
  function(m, c) bond.TCF(settle, m, c, freq, conv)$accrued,
  maturity, coupon
)]

# Full (dirty) price = clean price + accrued interest
portf[, fullprice := bd_price + accint]

# Face value = market value / (full price per $100)
portf[, face := mv / (fullprice / 100)]
```

```{r}
portf
```

```{r}
# Assemble the ladder bonds with their maturities, coupons, and liability payments
ladder <- df[, .(maturity, amount)]
ladder[, coupon := c(0.02000, 0.01625, 0.01500, 0.02250, 0.02250)]

# Merge in clean prices from the coupons dataset
ladder <- merge(ladder, coupons, by = c("maturity", "coupon"))
ladder <- ladder[order(maturity)]  # ensure chronological order

n    <- nrow(ladder)
face <- numeric(n)

# Last bond: its payment = face * (1 + coupon/2), solve for face
face[n] <- ladder$amount[n] / (1 + ladder$coupon[n] / 2)

# Backward recursion: for each earlier bond, subtract coupon income
# from longer-dated bonds still outstanding, then solve for face
for (i in (n - 1):1) {
  coupon_income <- sum(face[(i + 1):n] * ladder$coupon[(i + 1):n] / 2)
  needed        <- ladder$amount[i] - coupon_income
  face[i]       <- needed / (1 + ladder$coupon[i] / 2)
}

ladder[, face_value := face]
ladder[, .(maturity, coupon, amount, face_value)]
```

```{r}
# Define the diversified portfolio: 7 assets spanning domestic equity, international
# equity, fixed income, real estate, and commodities
asset_allocation <- data.table(
  name   = c("Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF",
             "Vanguard Developed Markets ETF",
             "Vanguard Emerging Markets ETF",
             "Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF",
             "Vanguard Real Estate ETF",
             "SPDR Gold Shares",
             "Invesco QQQ Trust"),
  ticker = c("VTI", "VEA", "VWO", "BND", "VNQ", "GLD", "QQQ"),
  wgt    = c(0.35, 0.15, 0.10, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05, 0.10)
)

# Verify weights sum to 1
stopifnot(sum(asset_allocation$wgt) == 1)

asset_allocation
```

## Interpretation limits

Prices are per 100 face value unless indicated. Results use the supplied historical snapshot and stated compounding conventions.
